about_short_description.short_description: Glide operates as a fintech platform that modernize community banks and credit unions.

product.name: Frictionless Account Opening & Onboarding
product.description: A digital platform for opening various account types quickly with personalized onboarding to support customer acquisition.

product.name: Unified Digital Loan Applications
product.description: A digital solution that streamlines loan application processes by unifying deposit and loan applications into a single interface.

product.name: AI-Powered Staff Experience
product.description: Tools that automate workflows and provide data aggregation and risk assessments to support staff decision-making in onboarding and lending.

product.name: Advanced Fraud Detection Tools
product.description: Security tools that use multiple risk signals to detect and prevent fraudulent account openings and loan applications.

product.name: Seamless Integrations
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Glide’s platform with popular core banking systems and tools to unify workflows.
